verified: TechCrunch reports that Gemini chat retention moves from 72 hours to two months, applies worldwide, applies even with history disabled, and rolls out over the coming weeks.
unconfirmed: Google's own announcement or help-center documentation of the change; the exact date each market switches over; whether any categories of chats are exempt; and whether content previously slated for deletion within 72 hours is now held longer.

verified: TechCrunch 报道称，谷歌将把 Gemini 聊天记录的保留期由 72 小时延长至两个月，覆盖全球用户，并在未来数周内分批推送，关闭历史记录的对话也在保留范围内。
unconfirmed: 该报报道未引用谷歌的官方公告原文，因此延长后的确切天数（“两个月”对应 60 天还是自然月）、各市场生效时间、是否适用于 Workspace 等付费版本，以及用户是否有其他退出选项，均缺乏一手信息确认。

titles.en: Google extends Gemini chat retention to two months, even with history off
titles.zh: 谷歌将 Gemini 聊天记录保留期从 72 小时延长至两月，关闭历史记录也不例外
